Go, Executive Vice President and Business Unit General Manager of Robinsons Land Corporation; and Joel Lumanlan, Vice President – Head of Operations and Marketing of Robinsons Malls.

blocks.html: Manila, Philippines — Opus, a premier lifestyle destination by Robinsons Land Corporation, reinforces its commitment to supporting future-ready, sustainable innovations with the official launch of Tesla’s newest V4 Supercharger hub located at Level 3, Mezzanine 1 of the mall.

The partnership marks a significant milestone in integrating future-ready mobility solutions within a modern retail environment, offering Tesla owners seamless access to fast, efficient charging while enjoying the mall’s curated dining, retail, and entertainment experiences.

At only P19/ kWh, the lowest charging rate in the Metro, and a max charging rate at 250 kW, the V4 Tesla Superchargers are designed for speed and efficiency to significantly reduce charging time. Working at peak charging rate, Model Y Premium Long Range RWD can add up to 267km in just 15 minutes.

“Sustainability is a core priority for RLC,” said Faraday Go, Executive Vice President and Business Unit General Manager of Robinsons Land. “The launch of Tesla Superchargers at Opus is another meaningful step forward, enabling cleaner transportation, reducing emissions, and supporting the government’s EV initiatives.”

Present during the inauguration were Isabel Fan, Senior Regional Director for HK, Macau & Southeast Asia of Tesla; Faraday D. Go, Executive Vice President and Business Unit General Manager of Robinsons Land Corporation; Lucky Jay Damaso, Corporate Energy Head Unit General Manager of Robinsons Land Corporation; and Joel Lumanlan, Vice President – Head of Operations and Marketing of Robinsons Malls.

“Our mission is to build a world of sustainable abundance,”Isabel Fan, Tesla’s Sr. Regional Director for HK, Macau, & Southeast Asia shared during her presentation, highlighting Tesla’s integrated approach to advancing mobility, energy, and technology. She emphasized that expanding the Supercharger network plays a critical role in accelerating the adoption of sustainable transportation worldwide.

Beyond infrastructure, the launch enhances the overall Tesla ownership experience at Opus. While charging, Tesla owners can enjoy exclusive Tesla Owners Club discounts at Olive Garden, transforming every charging stop into a rewarding lifestyle moment.
